article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Vincent Iwuchukwu had 28 points in Georgetown's 83-78 win against Delaware State on Tuesday. Iwuchukwu had 13 rebounds for the Hoyas (3-0). Kayvaun Mulready added 14 points while going 5 of 12 (3 for 8 from 3-point range) to go with six rebounds. Josiah Parker had 13 points and shot 5-for-5, including 3-for-3 from beyond the arc. Nehemiah Reedus finished with 19 points and four assists for the Hornets (1-2). Anthony Parker added 16 points, five assists and two steals for Delaware State. Joshua Obiora finished with 15 points and two steals. Iwuchukwu scored 11 points in the first half, and Georgetown went into halftime trailing 43-33. Iwuchukwu scored 17 points in the second half to help lead Georgetown to a five-point victory. Up next Georgetown next plays Friday against Clemson on the road, and Delaware State will visit East Carolina on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
